## 90-Minute Q3 Alignment Meeting Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

A focused agenda for **8 people** across product, design, and engineering on **2026-06-18 at 2:00 PM America/New_York**. The structure below leaves room for decisions, risks, and clear owners.

## Meeting Agenda and Decision Flow
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg

| Time | Block | Purpose | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2:00–2:05 PM | Kickoff and goals | Confirm meeting objective, scope, and decision criteria | Shared success definition |
| 2:05–2:20 PM | Q3 priorities review | Review the proposed priority list across product, design, and engineering | Agreed priority shortlist |
| 2:20–2:40 PM | Priority discussion | Compare trade-offs, dependencies, and capacity constraints | Ranked Q3 priorities |
| 2:40–3:00 PM | Launch milestones decision | Decide on **3 launch milestones** and their target dates | Final milestone set |
| 3:00–3:15 PM | Risks and blockers | Surface risks, unknowns, and cross-team dependencies | Risk log with owners |
| 3:15–3:25 PM | Action items and owners | Assign follow-ups, deadlines, and decision owners | Action list with due dates |
| 3:25–3:30 PM | Close and recap | Confirm decisions, next checkpoint, and communication plan | Meeting recap and next steps |

## Pre-Read Checklist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg

- Current Q3 priority proposal, with a short rationale for each item
- Capacity snapshot by function: product, design, engineering
- Draft launch milestone options, including dependencies
- Known risks, open questions, and unresolved trade-offs
- Metrics or success criteria that define a “good” Q3 outcome
- Any decisions needed from leadership or partner teams
- A shared notes doc with space for live updates during the meeting

## Follow-Up Email Template
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/phone.svg

**Subject:** Q3 Priorities, Launch Milestones, and Next Steps

Hi team,

Thanks for the productive discussion today. We aligned on the Q3 priorities, confirmed the three launch milestones, and captured the main risks and follow-up actions.

**Decisions made**
- Priority 1: [insert decision]
- Priority 2: [insert decision]
- Priority 3: [insert decision]
- Launch milestone 1: [insert milestone and date]
- Launch milestone 2: [insert milestone and date]
- Launch milestone 3: [insert milestone and date]

**Key risks**
- [Risk 1] — owner: [name]
- [Risk 2] — owner: [name]
- [Risk 3] — owner: [name]

**Action items**
- [Action] — owner: [name], due: [date]
- [Action] — owner: [name], due: [date]
- [Action] — owner: [name], due: [date]

Please review the notes and reply if anything was missed. I’ll share the updated plan and next checkpoint shortly.

Best,
[Your name]
